evidence.snippet: Plasma from patients with IgG4-RD exhibited elevated levels of reactivity against IL-1RA compared with plasma from the controls and neutralized IL-1RA activity, resulting in inflammatory and fibrotic mediator production in vitro.

nodes.description: Anti-IL-1RA antibodies in a subset can neutralize the endogenous IL-1 receptor antagonist and increase inflammatory and profibrotic mediator production. IgG4 predominates in many positive samples but other subclasses occur, and functional plasma experiments do not isolate IgG4-specific activity. The pathway is not universal or specific to IgG4-RD.

nodes.description: Patient B cells and plasmablasts have soluble profibrotic activity involving PDGF-B and additional mediators. Healthy-control B cells also have weaker collagen-promoting activity.

evidence.reference_title: B lymphocytes directly contribute to tissue fibrosis in patients with IgG(4)-related disease.
evidence.snippet: These findings demonstrate that CD19+ B lymphocytes from patients with IgG4-RD and, to lesser extent, from healthy individuals are capable of driving myofibroblast differentiation and collagen production through the secretion of soluble factors rather than physical interactions.

nodes.description: Provides biliary drainage when clinically indicated; anti-inflammatory treatment addresses the disease process.

nodes.description: Clonally expanded CD4-positive cytotoxic T lymphocytes infiltrate IgG4-RD lesions and produce inflammatory and profibrotic mediators, including IL-1beta, TGF-beta1, and IFN-gamma in salivary and lacrimal gland disease.

evidence.reference_title: Lesional CD4+ IFN-γ+ cytotoxic T lymphocytes in IgG4-related dacryoadenitis and sialoadenitis.

evidence.reference_title: CD4(+) and CD8(+) cytotoxic T lymphocytes may induce mesenchymal cell apoptosis in IgG(4)-related disease.
evidence.snippet: CD4+CTLs and CD8+CTLs may induce apoptotic cell death in tissues of patients with IgG4-RD with preferential targeting of nonendothelial, nonimmune cells of mesenchymal origin.

nodes.description: CXCL9/CXCL10-associated recruitment places CXCR3-positive T cells in inflamed mouse pancreas. evidence.snippet: Of these 86 patients, 32 (37%) had IgG4 antibodies to ≥1 of the 4 autoantigens and 12 (14%) showed reactivity with ≥2 of the tested antigens.

nodes.description: In poly(I:C)-induced autoimmune pancreatitis, TLR3-bearing conventional dendritic cells produce type I interferons and CXCL9/CXCL10 early, promoting subsequent CXCR3-positive T-cell recruitment. This initiating sequence is experimentally defined in female MRL/MpJ mice; matching human serum chemokines provide association rather than proof of the same sequence.

evidence.reference_title: A positive cytokine/chemokine feedback loop establishes plasmacytoid DC-driven autoimmune pancreatitis in IgG4-related disease.

nodes.description: In 234 IgG4-RD cases and 1170 matched controls, current smoking was associated with disease overall (OR 1.79, 95% CI 1.08–2.95), chiefly in the retroperitoneal-fibrosis subgroup. Excluding RPF removed the association. This is observational susceptibility evidence; effects of cessation on IgG4-RD activity were not tested.

evidence.reference_title: The association of smoking with immunoglobulin G4-related disease: a case-control study.
evidence.snippet: This association was strongest among female cases [13 (14%) vs 19 (4%);, OR 3.79 (95% CI 1.71, 8.39)] and those with retroperitoneal fibrosis [RPF; 13 (28%) vs 13 (6%);, OR 6.93 (95% CI 2.78, 17.26)]

evidence.reference_title: The association of smoking with immunoglobulin G4-related disease: a case-control study.
evidence.snippet: When RPF cases were excluded, there was no longer an association between current smoking and the odds of having IgG4-RD [12 (6%) vs 57 (6%); OR 0.95 (95% CI 0.49, 1.86)].

nodes.description: CD4-positive and CD8-positive cytotoxic T cells infiltrate lesions in association with HLA-DR-positive apoptotic cells, preferentially nonimmune and nonendothelial mesenchymal cells. GZMK-positive clones and extrafollicular B-cell proximity support coordinated inflammation. Human tissue data do not prove that CTLs cause obliterative phlebitis or that all T-cell populations are interchangeable.

evidence.reference_title: CD4(+) and CD8(+) cytotoxic T lymphocytes may induce mesenchymal cell apoptosis in IgG(4)-related disease.

evidence.reference_title: Granzyme K- and amphiregulin-expressing cytotoxic T cells and activated extrafollicular B cells are potential drivers of IgG4-related disease.

nodes.description: B-cell antibody production is enhanced through both T-cell-help and innate-cell-associated routes. Serum IgG4 does not faithfully report all lesions and can be normal. evidence.reference_title: Involvement of activation of toll-like receptors and nucleotide-binding oligomerization domain-like receptors in enhanced IgG4 responses in autoimmune pancreatitis.

evidence.reference_title: Toll-like receptor activation in basophils contributes to the development of IgG4-related disease.

evidence.reference_title: Clinical phenotypes of IgG4-related disease: an analysis of two international cross-sectional cohorts.
evidence.snippet: In the derivation cohort (n=493), we identified four groups with distinct manifestations: Group 1 (31%), Pancreato-Hepato-Biliary disease; Group 2 (24%), Retroperitoneal Fibrosis and/or Aortitis; Group 3 (24%), Head and Neck-Limited disease and Group 4 (22%), classic Mikulicz syndrome with systemic involvement.

nodes.description: Activated fibroblasts produce collagen and express myofibroblast programs. nodes.description: Glucocorticoids are used to induce control of active disease, with treatment and taper tailored to involved organs and response. nodes.description: IgG4-containing patient immune-complex fractions can activate and consume classical and lectin-pathway complement in vitro. evidence.reference_title: Possible participation of IgG4 in the activation of complement in IgG4-related disease with hypocomplementemia.

nodes.description: CD19-directed cytolytic antibody with an FDA indication for adult IgG4-RD. In MITIGATE, 135 participants received standardized glucocorticoid tapering; flare occurred in 10% versus 60% on placebo, with hazard ratio 0.13. Serious adverse events occurred in 18% versus 9%. Reduced flares demonstrate clinical efficacy but do not isolate antigen presentation, antibody production or direct profibrotic signaling as the necessary B-cell function.

evidence.reference_title: Inebilizumab for Treatment of IgG4-Related Disease.
evidence.snippet: Inebilizumab reduced the risk of flares of IgG4-related disease and increased the likelihood of flare-free complete remission at 1 year, confirming the role of CD19-targeted B-cell depletion as a potential treatment for IgG4-related disease.

nodes.description: Experimental cDC/T-cell/pDC recruitment and cytokine feedback with pancreatic inflammation and fibrosis.

evidence.reference_title: A positive cytokine/chemokine feedback loop establishes plasmacytoid DC-driven autoimmune pancreatitis in IgG4-related disease.
evidence.snippet: the blockade of the CCR9-CCL25 interaction by anti-CCL25 Ab markedly inhibited the development of experimental AIP

nodes.description: Intrinsic renal disease can produce urinary protein, with marked nephrosis in some membranous-nephropathy cases.

evidence.reference_title: Clinical Manifestations and Long-term Outcomes of IgG4-Related Kidney and Retroperitoneal Involvement in a United Kingdom IgG4-Related Disease Cohort.
evidence.snippet: Mild-to-moderate hemoproteinuria occurred in just over half of the patients with IgG4-RKD

nodes.description: Peribronchovascular thickening, nodules and ground-glass opacities may occur, with or without cough, dyspnea or chest pain. Thoracic disease can additionally involve pleura, mediastinum and lymph nodes; imaging and tissue findings require exclusion of infection, vasculitis and malignancy.

evidence.reference_title: Thoracic manifestations of IgG4-related disease.
evidence.snippet: Chest CT findings are heterogeneous and primarily include peribronchovascular thickening, nodules, ground-glass opacities and lymphadenopathy.

evidence.reference_title: Clinical Manifestations and Long-term Outcomes of IgG4-Related Kidney and Retroperitoneal Involvement in a United Kingdom IgG4-Related Disease Cohort.
evidence.snippet: Renal involvement may manifest as an intrinsic kidney disease (IgG4-RKD) or as a consequence of ureteric obstruction from retroperitoneal fibrosis (IgG4-RPF).

evidence.reference_title: Clinical Manifestations and Long-term Outcomes of IgG4-Related Kidney and Retroperitoneal Involvement in a United Kingdom IgG4-Related Disease Cohort.
evidence.snippet: Renal function deteriorated in 5 patients (20.8%), including 2 (8.3%) who reached end-stage renal disease (ESRD).

nodes.description: Tubulointerstitial inflammation with IgG4-rich plasma cells and fibrosis can impair intrinsic renal function. Membranous nephropathy occurs in a subset and may coexist. Hypocomplementemia is associated, but the reviewed evidence does not establish a single complement-mediated causal route for all renal injury.

evidence.reference_title: Clinical Manifestations and Long-term Outcomes of IgG4-Related Kidney and Retroperitoneal Involvement in a United Kingdom IgG4-Related Disease Cohort.
evidence.snippet: tubulointerstitial nephritis with abundant IgG4+ plasma cells was the most common finding (n = 14; 93.3%), and 4 (26.7%) patients had membranous nephropathy.

nodes.description: Periaortic and periureteric fibroinflammatory tissue can encase ureters and obstruct drainage, producing hydronephrosis and postrenal dysfunction. This route is distinct from intrinsic IgG4-related tubulointerstitial nephritis.

evidence.reference_title: Clinical Manifestations and Long-term Outcomes of IgG4-Related Kidney and Retroperitoneal Involvement in a United Kingdom IgG4-Related Disease Cohort.
evidence.snippet: Para-aortic or peri-ureteric RPF was evident in 14 patients (50%). This was associated with ureteric obstruction in 6 patients (21.4%)

evidence.reference_title: Clinical Manifestations and Long-term Outcomes of IgG4-Related Kidney and Retroperitoneal Involvement in a United Kingdom IgG4-Related Disease Cohort.
evidence.snippet: Para-aortic or peri-ureteric RPF was evident in 14 patients (50%). This was associated with ureteric obstruction in 6 patients (21.4%)

nodes.description: Anti-CD20 B-cell depletion used as a steroid-sparing approach. In an uncontrolled 30-patient trial, 97% had a disease response, 77% met the composite primary endpoint and 40% remained in complete remission at 12 months. These results support activity but do not constitute a randomized comparison or demonstrate elimination of mature plasma cells.

evidence.reference_title: Rituximab for IgG4-related disease: a prospective, open-label trial.
evidence.snippet: The primary outcome was achieved by 23 participants (77%). Fourteen (47%) were in complete remission at 6 months, and 12 (40%) remained in complete remission at 12 months.

nodes.description: Salivary gland enlargement, especially submandibular involvement, is characteristic; enlargement and secretory dysfunction are distinct findings. The ontology anchor is broader than enlargement because a gland-general enlargement term was not identified.

evidence.reference_title: IgG4-Related Disease: Clinical and Laboratory Features in One Hundred Twenty-Five Patients.
evidence.snippet: The most commonly involved organs were the submandibular glands (35 cases, 28%)

evidence.reference_title: Abatacept in IgG4-related disease: a prospective, open-label, single-arm, single-centre, proof-of-concept study.
evidence.snippet: IgG4-RD most commonly involves the major salivary glands, lacrimal glands, orbits, bile ducts, retroperitoneal tissues, aorta, kidneys, and lungs.

nodes.description: Immune-cell infiltration and tissue remodeling enlarge salivary and lacrimal glands. Persistent injury can compromise gland function; IgG4-rich inflammation alone does not distinguish this condition from all mimics.

evidence.reference_title: Abatacept in IgG4-related disease: a prospective, open-label, single-arm, single-centre, proof-of-concept study.
evidence.snippet: IgG4-RD most commonly involves the major salivary glands, lacrimal glands, orbits, bile ducts, retroperitoneal tissues, aorta, kidneys, and lungs.

evidence.reference_title: European Guideline on IgG4-related digestive disease - UEG and SGF evidence-based recommendations.
evidence.snippet: Indications for treatment are symptomatic patients with obstructive jaundice, abdominal pain, posterior pancreatic pain, and involvement of extra-pancreatic digestive organs, including IgG4-related cholangitis.

nodes.description: Endogenous nucleoside accumulation is associated with TLR7 activation, glandular chemokines and impaired saliva production.

evidence.reference_title: TLR7 responses to nucleosides drive sialadenitis in Slc29a3-deficient mice.
evidence.snippet: SLC29A3-deficiency specifically damaged Aqp5+ acinar and intercalated duct cells in SMGs

nodes.description: Fibrotic collagen remodeling can form a whorled or cartwheel storiform pattern. It is a characteristic microscopic architecture rather than a synonym for fibroblast activation. Fibrosis and inflammatory mass effects contribute to organ dysfunction; its prominence varies by organ and stage, and established scarring can be less reversible than active inflammation.

evidence.reference_title: IgG4-Related Disease: Clinical and Laboratory Features in One Hundred Twenty-Five Patients.
evidence.snippet: The major histopathologic features include a dense lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate, fibrosis that has a storiform pattern in focal (or diffuse) areas, and obliterative phlebitis.

nodes.description: TLR7-expressing CD163-positive macrophages accumulate in affected salivary glands. TLR7 agonist stimulation increases IL-33 in cultured macrophages; huTLR7 mice show multi-organ inflammation and fibrosis with IgG1, rather than human IgG4. Human temporal initiation remains unresolved.

evidence.reference_title: Activated M2 Macrophages Contribute to the Pathogenesis of IgG4-Related Disease via Toll-like Receptor 7/Interleukin-33 Signaling.
evidence.snippet: After in vitro stimulation with a TLR-7 agonist, CD163+ M2 macrophages produced higher levels of interleukin-33 (IL-33)

nodes.description: Follicular and extrafollicular helper T-cell populations provide B-cell help that promotes plasmablast differentiation and IgG4 production. Patient-derived circulating Tfh subsets and lesional salivary-gland Tfh cells have increased B-cell-helper activity in coculture. IL-4-positive BATF-positive and IL-10-positive LAG3-positive tissue populations are associated with polarized IgG4 responses; these phenotypes should not be treated as interchangeable with classical GATA3-positive Th2 cells.
nodes.id: Tfh-Mediated IgG4 Class Switching and Plasma Cell Differentiation

evidence.reference_title: Correlation of T follicular helper cells and plasmablasts with the development of organ involvement in patients with IgG4-related disease.
evidence.snippet: The association found between Tfh cells and plasmablasts, linked with biological plausibility, suggests that Tfh cells contribute to the pathogenesis of IgG4-RD.

evidence.reference_title: Enhanced IgG4 production by follicular helper 2 T cells and the involvement of follicular helper 1 T cells in the pathogenesis of IgG4-related disease.
evidence.snippet: In vitro, Tfh2 cells more efficiently induced the differentiation of naïve B cells into plasmablasts compared to Tfh1 or Tfh17 cells.

evidence.reference_title: Cutting Edge: A Critical Role of Lesional T Follicular Helper Cells in the Pathogenesis of IgG4-Related Disease.
evidence.snippet: Tfh cells from IgG4-DS submandibular glands had higher expression of B cell lymphoma 6 and a greater capacity to help B cells produce IgG4 than did tonsillar Tfh cells.

evidence.reference_title: Distinct disease-specific Tfh cell populations in 2 different fibrotic diseases: IgG(4)-related disease and Kimura disease.
evidence.snippet: We encountered abundant infiltrating IL-10-expressing LAG3+ Tfh cells in patients with IgG4-RD.

nodes.description: Relieves urinary obstruction when indicated, alongside management of active systemic disease.

evidence.reference_title: IgG4-Related Disease: Clinical and Laboratory Features in One Hundred Twenty-Five Patients.
evidence.snippet: Sixteen patients (13%) had received either ureteral or biliary tract stents for complications related to IgG4-RD (8 ureteral stents, 8 biliary stents).
